title: How PDF-First Publishing Works
excerpt: This reusable example shows how a short article can introduce and embed an original PDF without requiring a database.
body:
## One document, one permanent article page

An editor enters a headline and summary, uploads a PDF, and publishes. The build creates the article page, archive entry, and embedded document viewer automatically.

- The publication remains entirely static.
- The PDF stays available as an original download.
- Every source change is preserved in Git history.
